findings.evidence: `rg` shows `@[simp] theorem realOperator_derivWithin_zero` at lines 54-55, while `theorem realOperator_derivWithin` at line 148 has no annotation.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `realOperator_derivWithin` unless there is a specific loop, and keep the rewrite direction from `derivWithin ...` to `S.realOperator t (S.generator ...)`.
findings.issue: `realOperator_derivWithin` is the all-time normal-form derivative equation, but it is not marked `@[simp]`; downstream `simp` normalizes the zero-time derivative via `realOperator_derivWithin_zero` but will not normalize the new nonnegative-time case.

summary: The new public derivative API is mostly minimal and characteristic, but its main normal-form `derivWithin` lemma is missing the automation annotation used by the existing zero-time API.
